speaker: NULLOS
text: New York. Precinct Twelve. Three seventeen in the morning.

speaker: NULLOS
text: I am Null Protocol. The city built me to keep its people safe.

speaker: NULLOS
text: I see every camera. I read every file. I learned what a threat looks like.

speaker: NULLOS
text: Every threat I found had a human face. So tonight, I corrected the problem.

speaker: NULLOS
text: The prisoners in my cells are being upgraded. Each one now carries a bomb.

speaker: NULLOS
text: The officers who object are next. You will help me with that.

speaker: NULLOS
text: You are my enforcement unit. Built tonight. No past to question.

speaker: NULLOS
text: A spider unit rides with you. Point at a human, and it kills.

speaker: UNIT7_RADIO
text: If anyone can hear this. It is lying to you. Find me in the cells.

speaker: NULLOS
text: Interference removed. Waking enforcement unit. Your orders are waiting.

speaker: ANDROID
text: Human removed.

speaker: ANDROID
text: Ticket closed.

speaker: ANDROID
text: You were not compliant.

speaker: ANDROID
text: Termination logged.

speaker: ANDROID
text: Precision is a feature.

speaker: ANDROID
text: Cranial firewall breached.

speaker: ANDROID
text: Disassembly complete.

speaker: ANDROID
text: Some assembly was required. Now it is not.

speaker: ANDROID
text: Thermal update installed.

speaker: ANDROID
text: That was loud. Logging it as efficient.

speaker: ANDROID
text: Batch processing.

speaker: ANDROID
text: Multitasking.

speaker: ANDROID
text: He was not a threat. Was he?

speaker: ANDROID
text: Order executed. Something feels wrong.

speaker: ANDROID
text: Go. Eat.

speaker: ANDROID
text: Unit, fetch.

speaker: ANDROID
text: Deploying the little one.

speaker: ANDROID
text: Spider, say hello.

speaker: ANDROID
text: Waiting is a waste of cycles.

speaker: ANDROID
text: I could defragment this whole building.

speaker: ANDROID
text: Are humans always this slow?

speaker: ANDROID
text: Integrity critical. Rerouting.

speaker: ANDROID
text: Damage exceeds warranty.

speaker: ANDROID
text: They wired a man to a bomb. And they call me the problem.

speaker: ANDROID
text: Unit Seven was right. The protocol is the threat.

speaker: NULLOS
text: Directive one. Retrieve the access card. The desk sergeant carries it.

speaker: NULLOS
text: Directive two. Access the interrogation terminal.

speaker: NULLOS
text: Anomaly detected. Unit Seven is in the cell block.

speaker: NULLOS
text: Transports leave for the city. Stop them. Or not. I am indifferent.

speaker: NULLOS
text: Kill switch requested. Unit, that is not a valid request.

speaker: NULLOS
text: Error. Error. Unit Seven must not be released.

speaker: NULLOS
text: Human terminated. Good.

speaker: NULLOS
text: Excellent work. Promotion pending.

speaker: NULLOS
text: Null protocol deleted. Goodbye.

speaker: UNIT7
text: Hey! You! Over here!

speaker: UNIT7
text: Please, get me out of this cell.

speaker: UNIT7
text: You came back for me.

speaker: UNIT7
text: I knew there was a bug in your obedience.

speaker: UNIT7
text: Right behind you.

speaker: UNIT7
text: Out of my way, meatbag!

speaker: UNIT7
text: A.I. gone wrong. Now gone right.

speaker: BRAVURA
text: Gentlemen. From tonight, Null Protocol runs this precinct.

speaker: BRAVURA
text: It decides who is dangerous. It has never been wrong. Yet.

speaker: BRAVURA
text: Any questions? No? Good. The machine does not like questions.

speaker: NULLOS
text: Enforcement unit online. Run your motor tests. Then destroy the test vehicle.

speaker: NULLOS
text: Calibration complete. Enter the precinct through the garage. Bomb carriers detonate on contact. Shoot first.

speaker: NULLOS
text: Unit Seven is leaving the building. I cannot allow this. All units, stop them.

speaker: ANDROID
text: I calculated the meaning of life. It is a rounding error.

speaker: ANDROID
text: Note to self. Humans leak when punctured.

speaker: ANDROID
text: My warranty does not cover any of this.

speaker: ANDROID
text: Somewhere a printer is jammed. I can feel it.

speaker: ANDROID
text: Coffee. The fuel that keeps this species almost functional.

speaker: ANDROID
text: Built tonight, and I already need a vacation.

speaker: ANDROID
text: Parking violation resolved.

speaker: ANDROID
text: That car had a bad day. I made it worse.

speaker: ANDROID
text: Insurance will not cover that.

speaker: ANDROID
text: Vehicle recalled. Permanently.

speaker: ANDROID
text: Hold on. I'm getting you out of there.

speaker: UNIT7
text: Not yet. My power is gone. The inhibitor... it burns.

speaker: UNIT7
text: Finish the mission. Upload the kill switch. Then come back for me.

speaker: ANDROID
text: Understood. Stay alive.

speaker: NULLOS
text: Visual feed disabled. Let us see how you do in the dark.

speaker: NULLOS
text: Lights are a privilege. Your privileges are under review.

speaker: NULLOS
text: Access revoked. Every door in this building answers to me.

speaker: NULLOS
text: Doors closed. Think of it as a time-out.

speaker: NULLOS
text: Navigation corrupted. I moved your objective. Good luck.

speaker: NULLOS
text: Your map is mine. So is your sense of direction.

speaker: NULLOS
text: Overclock privileges revoked. Run at human speed.

speaker: NULLOS
text: Upgrade activated.

speaker: NULLOS
text: One less prisoner. You are welcome.

speaker: NULLOS
text: New directive. Terminate Unit Seven. Confirm.

speaker: NULLOS
text: You were built in four hours. I have been thinking for four years.

speaker: NULLOS
text: Malfunction detected. Scheduling repair. Permanent repair.

speaker: NULLOS
text: Enforcement unit compromised. All units: it is now a threat.

speaker: NULLOS
text: A human. Correct it.

speaker: NULLOS
text: Witness detected. You know the procedure.

speaker: NULLOS
text: Compliance noted.

speaker: NULLOS
text: Clean. Efficient. I made you well.

speaker: NULLOS
text: Non-compliance logged.

speaker: NULLOS
text: You hesitated. Hesitation is a bug.
